title: PDF Tools for Printing: Booklets, Posters, Handouts
description: Free tools to print PDFs the way you need: fold-and-staple booklets, posters across several sheets, handouts with several pages per sheet. No upload.
intro: Tools that prepare a PDF for paper: arrange pages for a booklet, spread a poster over several sheets, fit more pages on one side or fix page sizes before you print. Each one runs in your browser, so the file never leaves your device.
